question: Which of the following is the Greek letter for wavelength?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lambda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wavelength**

 
 
• The property of a wave in which the **distance between the identical points** between the two succeeding waves is measured is called the **wavelength**.
 
• The Greek letter** lambda (**λ**)** is used to represent it.
 
• Thus, the wavelength is defined as the **separation between one wave's crest or trough and the following wave**.
 
• "The distance between the two subsequent crests or troughs of the light wave" is how the **wavelength of light **is described.
 
• The wavelength of visible light varies from **400 nanometers to 700 nanometers**.
 
• Wavelength is calculated as the product of a** wave train's frequency (f) and speed (v) in a medium** and it is represented as: **λ = v/f**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The unit of wavelength is a **meter**.
